correctness.rationale: Genus 4 follows from the six tame triple branch points, and genus 2 from exactly two fixed points of the involution. Four regular 1-forms explicitly span H^0(Omega). Direct coefficient extraction in f^2 and f^4 gives the listed block matrices; both modulo-seven polynomial identities and the 47 smooth F49 parameters are replayed by artifacts/verify.py. The anti-invariant determinant is 2(a^2-4), nonzero exactly on the smooth domain; the two invariant entries vanish together exactly at a^2=-2. Prime-to-seven Prym/quotient isogeny identifies p-ranks. Computation does not stand in for the universal polynomial proof.

value.rationale: An involution-selected natural complete smooth odd-polynomial pencil has a quotient of genus two and Prym dimension two. Identifying its globally ordinary Prym and isolated superspecial quotient yields a structural all-parameter theorem, a sharp missing-rank phenomenon, and an exact geometric exceptional locus; it does not follow from the general absence of superspecial genus-four curves.
